}

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
y=dA_dt
def f(p):
    return p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*t**2)-p[2]*A**p[3]*t**p[4]*np.exp(-p[5]*t**2)-p[6]*A**p[7]*np.exp(-p[8]*A*t)
def nm(p): return np.mean((f(p)-y)**2)/np.var(y)
rng=np.random.default_rng(5)
best=None;bc=np.inf
base=[10.0162,0.0151,0.3025,2.5697,0.2042,0.0073]
for trial in range(120):
    p0=np.r_[base[:6], rng.uniform(0.01,0.5), rng.uniform(1,3), rng.uniform(0,1)]
    p0[6]=rng.uniform(0.01,0.5) if trial%2 else 0.05
    p0[0]=rng.uniform(9,11)
    try:
        r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(f(p)-y,nan=1e6,posinf=1e6,neginf=-1e6), p0, max_nfev=3000)
        if r.cost<bc: bc=r.cost; best=r
    except Exception: pass
print(nm(best.x), np.round(best.x,5).tolist())
